Health Canada approved MYQORZO (aficamten) for adults with symptomatic obstructive HCM — the drug's fifth regulatory approval in under a year (following US, China, EU, UK). Stock reportedly rose on the news; exact percentage move not confirmed this pass.

Additional ACACIA-HCM (aficamten, non-obstructive HCM) safety and efficacy data presented at HFSA 2026: serious heart-failure adverse events in 12 patients (4.7%) on aficamten vs. 3 (1.2%) on placebo; LVEF <50% occurred in 27 patients (10%) on aficamten vs. 2 (1%) on placebo; overall serious adverse events 52 (20.2%) vs. 38 (14.7%); heart-failure events occurred during dose titration or before Week 12, often following a trigger such as rapid atrial fibrillation or infection. Independently confirms and supersedes the prior pass's unverified Oct 9 HFSA catalyst entry.
